what: Addendum to 00835 (its prerequisite 00834 is done): open the trees with `let section = image.section(SectionId::SYNTAX_TREES, base_db::trees::SCHEMA)?; let bytes = image.whole_bytes(&section)?; base_db::trees::Trees::open(bytes)` (image: Arc<Image<Mapping>>); a Missing section means start with no stored trees, any other Refused/Corrupt/TreeError is reported, never ignored.

history.note: Wired. Start (serve/daemon.rs, after the history, before any front end's Db is made): serve/image.rs `trees(image)` opens SectionId::SYNTAX_TREES with base_db::trees::SCHEMA via whole_bytes and Trees::open; Ok -> base_db::trees::install(Arc::new(trees)); Missing -> none; a schema refusal, Corrupt or TreeError -> Started.trees = Some(why) (in Started's Display and whole(), reported with the start; library files then parse), never ignored. Image (serve/image.rs make): Parts gains `front: Option<&base_db::Db>` (Jobs::front_db: the first root's kept front end, via a new work.rs trait KeptDb that Steps::KeptFront implements; the fakes' is None), and with one the section is base_db::trees::write_section(front, ..) added under SYNTAX_TREES; db.trees().failed() is logged (tracing::warn) when set. With no front kept at image time (all checked out by running jobs) the image has no trees section and the next start parses them: one Db's trees only, as write_section takes one Db; several checkouts keep the first root's. admit_parses: blaze-lower Lowered::refresh calls db.admit_parses() once per revision before its batch of file writes.
